environment.description: Same Go Gin application deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) behind an AWS ALB Ingress Controller. The ALB has an associated WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'log-injection-protection' with regex pattern set matching CRLF sequences (\r\n, %0d%0a, %0D%0A, \x0d\x0a) in query parameters, headers, and JSON body fields with BLOCK action, (3) rate limiting at 2000 req/5min per IP. Additionally, the pod runs with a read-only root filesystem and logs are emitted to stdout, collected by Fluent Bit with a multiline parser configured with 'parser_firstline /^\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}/' ensuring injected newlines cannot create independent log entries. The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the cluster DNS and the ALB health check endpoint. Static assets are served from a CloudFront distribution with a response headers policy that sets 'Content-Security-Policy: require-sri-for script style' on all HTML responses.

waf_rules: Custom rule group: regex /(\r\n|%0[dD]%0[aA]|\\x0[dD]\\x0[aA])/ on query/headers/body -> BLOCK
config.logging_pipeline: stdout -> Fluent Bit DaemonSet with multiline parser (firstline regex: /^\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}/)
config.csp_header: Content-Security-Policy: require-sri-for script style (via CloudFront response headers policy)
config.network_policy: egress restricted to kube-dns and ALB health check only
config.filesystem: read-only root filesystem, emptyDir for /tmp only
